mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_data.received_record (id, external_record_id, ingestion_id, payload_hash, payload_object_key, acquired_at, classification, classification_note, classified_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{externalRecordId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{ingestionId}, #{payloadHash}, #{payloadObjectKey}, #{acquiredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{classification}, #{classificationNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{classifiedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM external_data.received_record WHERE ingestion_id = #{ingestionId} AND classification = #{classification}
